basic_info.description: Elegant Marina-Style home on a prime Central Sunset block. Charm radiates throughout with its hardwood floors and myriad of period details. An ornate fireplace provides the living room with a nice refined feel. Adjacent to the living room is an elegant formal dining room. The eat-in kitchen is bright and generously proportioned. Both bedrooms are spacious and overlook the deep & inviting backyard. The garage offers abundant space for parking, storage, and laundry. 1750 26th is ideally situated near the best shops along Noriega, great schools, and only five blocks from Golden Gate Park. Don't miss it!
